title: Essential Knots & Rope Skills
description: Teaches ten essential knots, including the bowline, clove hitch, taut-line hitch, trucker's hitch, and Prusik, with a quick guide to which knot to use when. Covers rope inspection and retirement, paracord specs and uses, and square, diagonal, and tripod lashings for shelters.
shortDescription: Ten survival knots, paracord uses, rope care, and shelter lashings
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
